compiled_state.description:
## Context
Bug 4dd1-7963-e15e-4e2c fixed the compaction sweep running unbounded git history walks inside the store write lock for signed events its --no-merges position map misses. How often the production server hits that path is unmeasured.

## Approach
Read-only, on the MCP server's tickets clone via SSM: count signed events whose only adding commit is a merge commit, on a COPY or with a bounded git invocation, never mutating the live store.

## Testing
Read-only command output recorded on the ticket; no code change.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The count of merge-only signed events in the server clone is recorded with the command used and its timestamp (checked: ticket comment).
compiled_state.title: Measure how often the production compaction sweep misses the position map
